plan.follow_up: Return for reassessment if not improving over the next week, or if the cough persists beyond three weeks.
plan.treatment: Rest, Adequate fluid intake, Warm salt-water gargles, Antibiotics not recommended
plan.medications: Paracetamol (for sore throat or fever, as needed), Saline nasal spray (for nasal congestion, as needed), Simple cough medicine (at night if cough disrupts sleep, as needed)
plan.safety_netting: Seek urgent medical attention if experiencing difficulty breathing, chest pain, coughing up blood, severe difficulty swallowing, persistent high fever, or sudden clinical worsening.
plan.patient_instructions: Rest and drink plenty of fluids., Gargle with warm salt water to help soothe throat pain., Use saline nasal spray for congestion., Take paracetamol as needed for sore throat or fever., Use a simple cough medicine at night if the cough keeps you awake.

objective.examination: Throat: Mildly red, no pus or significant swelling. Nose: Congested with clear discharge. Neck: Mild tenderness around neck glands. Chest: Clear, no wheezing or crackles, breathing comfortably.

assessment.clinical_impression: Symptoms and physical findings are most consistent with a viral upper respiratory tract infection. No clinical findings to suggest pneumonia or a serious throat infection.

history.onset: Sore throat started 5 days ago, followed by a cough starting 4 days ago.
history.progression: Sore throat was worse initially but is slowly improving. Cough is present during the day but is significantly worse at night, causing sleep disruption.

subjective.symptoms: Dry cough (occasional clear mucus), Sore throat (painful swallowing), Feverishness (first 2 days, measured once at 38°C), Chills (first night), Nasal congestion, Runny nose (clear discharge), Sneezing, Mild headache, Fatigue
subjective.social_history: Never smoked. No vaping. Alcohol: 1-2 drinks on weekends.
subjective.relevant_negatives: No body aches, No shortness of breath, No chest pain, No wheezing, No coughing up blood, No difficulty swallowing liquids, No drooling, No sensation of throat closing, No neck swelling, No loss of taste or smell, No increased use of asthma inhaler

investigations.results: Home COVID-19 test: Negative (completed 2 days ago)
